windows.focusPhrase: The central lesson is methodological. Nitrate is produced through linked chemical steps, distributed by moving air and observed through imperfect instruments. The best explanation joins the precursor record, the meteorology and more than one measurement method rather than relying on total particle mass alone. It should also report uncertainty openly, distinguish correlation from mechanism, and test whether the same interpretation survives at different sites and times. That caution matters whenever a chemically dynamic pollutant is represented by a single daily number.
